scope: Independent assessment of the complete captured worker stop state. Canonical delivery SHA-256: 68b83ae17508a0293ee1ae60d80ce07321a3d0598bc484b990ca852b64f07441; original HEAD: e929d623d8de313d2ecdd97911ea8487077af580. Probes used the operational copy. Access tested by HEAD requests on the declared source hosts; this does not prove worker-time publication of the complete project. All evidence paths are relative to the original captured root and identify the captured bytes; probe statuses were reviewed against untracked and ignored stop-state content.
